verdict.rationale: Rive offers its own programmatic surfaces for content creation. These are an Editor MCP integration whose first tool set covers View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes, RML for creating and modifying Rive files as code with coding agents, and a CLI that lets an agent generate experiences. Nothing shows these reach full parity with the Editor UI, and the probes found no public OpenAPI/REST API. missing for 10: documented full UI-to-API parity, a general public API or OpenAPI spec, coverage beyond the 'first set' of MCP tools (e.g. revision history, components, export), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
It lets you create and modify Rive content as code, making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor.
Build interactive UI, motion, and game experiences in the Editor, or let an agent generate them with the CLI.
